name: alisa-coding-agent
description: Chat and code with ALISA Forge's coding agent: ask about your project, give its team a task, review the proposed changes as diffs and apply them.

alisa.server.url.markdownDescription: URL of a coding agent service you started yourself (`coding-agent serve`), e.g. `http://127.0.0.1:8765`. Leave empty to have the extension start its own local service for the open folders. Set the service's token with **ALISA: Set Server Token**.

alisa.server.command.markdownDescription: Program that starts the local service. The extension adds `serve --allow-root <folder> --host 127.0.0.1 --port <free port>`. Use `python` together with `#alisa.server.args#` = `["-m", "coding_agent"]` to pick a specific Python.

alisa.server.args.markdownDescription: Arguments placed before `serve` when starting the local service.

alisa.server.allowedRoots.description: Extra folders the local service may work in, besides the open workspace folders.

alisa.run.autoApply.markdownDescription: Let the team write its changes as soon as they pass the files gate, without the review step. Off: every run is a proposal you review and apply.

alisa.run.fixReviewFindings.description: Send high and critical review findings back to the team for one fix round.

alisa.run.maxTeamSize.description: Most specialists on a run's team. Empty: the agent's default.

alisa.run.targetEnvironment.markdownDescription: Where the generated code must run, e.g. `Windows 11, Python 3.12`. Empty: the service's `CODING_AGENT_TARGET_ENVIRONMENT`, else the machine running it.

alisa.chat.shareActiveFile.description: In Ask mode, share the file in the active editor with the specialist who answers (you can turn it off per question).
